variable_basic:
<?php
class C { public static function twice($x) { echo "M|$x|"; return $x * 2; } }
$f = 'C::twice';
echo (7 |> $f), '|';
literal_basic:
<?php
class C { public static function twice($x) { echo "M|$x|"; return $x * 2; } }
echo (8 |> 'C::twice'), '|';
variable_byref_send:
<?php
class C { public static function set(&$x) { echo 'ENTER|'; } }
$f = 'C::set';
try {
    5 |> $f;
} catch (Error $e) {
    echo get_class($e), '|', $e->getMessage(), '|', $e->getLine(), '|';
}
variable_lookup_line:
<?php
class C {}
$f = 'C::missing';
try {
    4 |>
        $f;
} catch (Error $e) {
    echo get_class($e), '|', $e->getMessage(), '|', $e->getLine(), '|';
}
variable_strict:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class C { public static function take(int $x) { echo 'ENTER|'; } }
$f = 'C::take';
try {
    '3' |> $f;
} catch (TypeError $e) {
    echo get_class($e), '|', $e->getMessage(), '|', $e->getLine(), '|';
}
variable_ref_return:
<?php
$v = 0;
class C { public static function &slot($x) { global $v; echo "S|$x|"; return $v; } }
function set(&$x) { $x = 9; echo 'T|'; }
$f = 'C::slot';
set(1 |> $f);
echo $v, '|';
variable_inherited:
<?php
class A { public static function who($x) { echo static::class, '|', $x, '|'; } }
class B extends A {}
$f = 'B::who';
0 |> $f;
independent_byref_owner:
<?php
class L { public function __destruct() { echo 'L|'; } }
class C { public static function set(&$x) { echo 'ENTER|'; } }
$f = 'C::set';
try {
    (new L) |> $f;
} catch (Error $e) {
    echo 'E|', $e->getMessage(), '|';
}
factory_temporary:
